name: EtridButtonExcemple
summary: This is a utility EA that demonstrates how to create and handle graphical button controls on an MQL5 chart. It provides an example of interactive UI elements for MetaTrader 5, allowing users to place buttons on the chart that can trigger actions or change states. The EA does not open trades on its own but serves as a template for building custom chart-based interfaces.
summary_zh: 这是一个工具类EA，演示了如何在MQL5图表上创建和处理图形按钮控件。它提供了MetaTrader 5交互式UI元素的示例，允许用户在图表上放置按钮来触发操作或改变状态。该EA不会自行开仓交易，而是作为构建自定义图表界面的模板。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略，而是一个图形界面工具示例。它的核心功能是创建图表按钮控件，并处理按钮的点击事件。入场条件和出场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理同样不适用。其主要用途是为开发者提供一个参考模板，展示如何在MQL5中使用OBJ_BUTTON对象和OnChartEvent事件处理函数来构建交互式界面。开发者可以基于此模板扩展更复杂的面板、仪表盘或交易控制界面。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a graphical interface utility example. Its core functionality is creating chart button controls and handling button click events. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute any trading operations. Position sizing and money management are likewise not applicable. Its primary purpose is to provide a reference template for developers, demonstrating how to use OBJ_BUTTON objects and the OnChartEvent handler in MQL5 to build interactive interfaces. Developers can extend this template to create more complex panels, dashboards, or trade control interfaces based on the button handling pattern shown here.

pros: 提供了MQL5图形按钮创建的清晰示例代码
使用OnChartEvent事件驱动模式，响应及时
可作为开发自定义交易面板的基础模板
pros_en: Provides clear example code for creating MQL5 graphical buttons
Uses OnChartEvent event-driven pattern for responsive interaction
Serves as a foundational template for developing custom trading panels
cons: 仅是示例代码，功能单一，缺乏实际交易逻辑
缺乏错误处理和边界情况检查
没有持久化按钮状态，EA重启后界面需重建
cons_en: Only example code with limited functionality, lacks actual trading logic
Lacks error handling and boundary condition checks
No persistence of button state; UI must be rebuilt after EA restart
improvements: 增加更多控件类型如下拉框、输入框等，丰富界面功能
添加按钮状态的持久化保存机制，EA重启后自动恢复界面
improvements_en: Add more control types like dropdowns and input fields to enrich UI functionality
Implement button state persistence so the UI auto-restores after EA restart

risk_points: 作为工具类EA无交易风险

risk_points_en: No trading risk as a utility EA
If extended into a trading panel, button actions could directly trigger trades requiring caution
